name: Nandaar
source:
Nandaar – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and a Sarantales class mentor.

A matured black yellow-eyed om'verai with wavy light eyebrows. Nandaar's wing membranes have darker color and his head is covered with mohawk-styled spikes. Nandaar has 2 light cheek horns and light belly plates. One of Nandaar's horns is implanted.

Nandaar is a disciplined om'verai, providing his students with hard and painful training. Azaries describes him as a "cheerful strong and justicing trainer". A drinker with a good sense of humor.
